strings.zh: 欢迎来到桔梗市的名胜——喇叭芽之塔。
strings.en: Welcome to Violet City’s famous{NEWLINE}landmark, Sprout Tower.

strings.zh: 这座喇叭芽之塔{NEWLINE}是古人为了锻炼精灵而建造的。{CLEAR}按照古老的习俗,要想登上塔顶{CLEAR}就必须突破修行者们的重重阻挠。{SCROLL}当然现在时代变了,{NEWLINE}不是训练家的普通游客{CLEAR}也可以付费前往塔顶参观。
strings.en: This Sprout Tower was built by{NEWLINE}people long ago to train Pokémon. By{CLEAR}ancient custom, anyone who wants to{CLEAR}reach the top must break through{CLEAR}the monks who stand in the way.{SCROLL}Of course, times have changed. Now{NEWLINE}ordinary visitors who aren’t Trainers{CLEAR}can pay to go up and see the top.

strings.zh: 高达３０米的{NEWLINE}巨大喇叭芽,{SCROLL}据说是它的身体{NEWLINE}化作了这座塔{CLEAR}中央的柱子。
strings.en: A giant Bellsprout, 30 meters tall...{SCROLL}People say its body became the{NEWLINE}pillar in the middle of this tower.

strings.zh: 是不是觉得柱子在摇晃？{NEWLINE}这上面还有{CLEAR}和尚们在修行呢。
strings.en: Do you feel the pillar swaying?{NEWLINE}There are monks training up there.

strings.zh: 被供奉的精灵……{NEWLINE}感到有一丝神圣感。
strings.en: An enshrined Pokémon... You sense a{NEWLINE}hint of holiness.
strings.notes: US 0054/4 | RV030: meaning: enshrined/sacred feeling, not a distinguished-looking statue (D-1687)

strings.zh: 爆太郎『Cyyy——da！
strings.en: Exbo: Cyyy-da!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,我准备试试{NEWLINE}这个喇叭芽之塔的修行挑战,{CLEAR}看能不能登上塔的最顶层。{CLEAR}在那之前你能跟我来一场对战热身吗？
strings.en: Gold: Idol, I’m gonna take on Sprout{NEWLINE}Tower’s training challenge and see{CLEAR}if I can make it to the top floor.{CLEAR}Can you battle me first, to warm up?

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,这可是咱们第一次对战,{NEWLINE}我会全力以赴的！
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh, this is our first{NEWLINE}battle ever. I’m going all out!

strings.zh: 阿金『不愧是偶像,{NEWLINE}我完全没有还手之力！{CLEAR}看来我需要好好调整一下队伍的状态{CLEAR}再进行登塔修行了。
strings.en: Gold: That’s my idol! I couldn’t even{NEWLINE}fight back! Guess I’d better get my{CLEAR}team in shape before I climb the tower.

strings.zh: 阿金『唉？不想打吗？{NEWLINE}难得有机会让偶像指点我两招。
strings.en: Gold: Huh? You don’t want to?{NEWLINE}It’s not every day I get to have{CLEAR}my idol show me a thing or two.

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,我正在调整队伍的状态{NEWLINE}为登塔修行做最后的准备。
strings.en: Gold: Idol, I’m getting my{NEWLINE}team in shape. Final prep{CLEAR}before I climb the tower.

strings.zh: 施主您好,欢迎来到喇叭芽之塔。{NEWLINE}您可有意施舍些香火钱{CLEAR}为自己和精灵祈福吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Greetings, traveler, and welcome to{NEWLINE}Sprout Tower. Would you care to make{CLEAR}an offering, to pray for blessings{CLEAR}on yourself and your Pokémon?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: Offering/donation prompts #11, #18, #34 are followed by a yes/no in script.

strings.zh: 这么说您是来登塔修行的了,{NEWLINE}那就让我看看您的实力！
strings.en: So you have come to climb the tower and{NEWLINE}train. Then let me see your strength!

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,善哉善哉。
strings.en: Amitabha. Blessed, most blessed.

strings.zh: 喇叭芽,请为施主让路吧。
strings.en: Bellsprout, please make{NEWLINE}way for the traveler.

strings.zh: 喇叭芽『Bel——rou！
strings.en: Bellsprout: Bel-rou!

strings.zh: 要想修行取得成果,{NEWLINE}就要克服肉体上的惰性,{CLEAR}这是一切功德的开始。
strings.en: If you wish your training to bear fruit,{NEWLINE}you must overcome the laziness of the{CLEAR}body. That is where all merit begins.

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛。{NEWLINE}钱不在多,心诚则灵。
strings.en: Amitabha. It is not the amount of money{NEWLINE}that matters. Sincerity is what counts.

strings.zh: 施主您好,喇叭芽之塔的维护保养{NEWLINE}是一笔不小的开支,{CLEAR}您愿意出一笔功德钱帮助我们吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Greetings, traveler. The upkeep{NEWLINE}of Sprout Tower is no small{CLEAR}expense. Would you be willing{CLEAR}to make a donation to help us?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 看来您是专程来登塔修行的,{NEWLINE}那我可不能怠慢了贵客,请接招吧！
strings.en: I see you have come especially{NEWLINE}to climb the tower and train.{CLEAR}Then I must not neglect such{CLEAR}an honored guest. Have at you!

strings.zh: 按理说我们这些修行者{NEWLINE}应该彻底断绝金钱之欲,{CLEAR}但每次为了维修喇叭芽之塔{CLEAR}募集到功德钱时,{CLEAR}我又会发自内心的开心。{SCROLL}所以募集功德钱{NEWLINE}对于修行到底有用还是没用？{CLEAR}我实在是参不透啊……
strings.en: By rights, we who train here should{NEWLINE}cut off all desire for money entirely.{CLEAR}Yet each time we collect donations{CLEAR}to repair Sprout Tower, I feel a{CLEAR}joy from the bottom of my heart.{SCROLL}So is collecting donations{NEWLINE}good for our training, or not? I{CLEAR}truly cannot see through this...

strings.zh: 咳,是你啊。我还以为{NEWLINE}长老又来抓我偷吃狗肉呢。{SCROLL}你还记得洒家吗？{NEWLINE}当年在圣安努号上{CLEAR}多亏你出手相助,{CLEAR}洒家等人才能全身而退。{CLEAR}不想竟在这里久别重逢。{SCROLL}来来来,先与洒家痛痛快快{NEWLINE}打上一场再说！
strings.en: *cough* Oh, it’s you. I thought the{NEWLINE}Elder had come to catch me sneaking dog{CLEAR}meat again.{SCROLL}Do you remember this old boy? Back on{NEWLINE}the S.S. Anne, you lent us a hand, and{CLEAR}this old boy and the others got out in{CLEAR}one piece. Who’d have thought we’d meet{CLEAR}again here after so long?{SCROLL}Come, come! First, let’s have a good,{NEWLINE}hearty battle!
strings.notes: Drinking, dog-eating monk (洒家 ‘this old boy’) is the same S.S. Anne survivor as 0371 #7–#10 (shared lines identical). | RV030: addition: 洒家等人 is ‘me and the others’, no crew

strings.zh: 哈哈,厉害厉害！{NEWLINE}不亏是当年击退火箭队的英雄。{CLEAR}洒家回到城都后,就一直遗憾{CLEAR}当时没能报答你的救命之恩,{CLEAR}正好现在把这个送给你{CLEAR}就当做是谢礼吧！
strings.en: Ha ha! Impressive, impressive! Just{NEWLINE}what I’d expect of the hero who{CLEAR}drove off Team Rocket back then.{SCROLL}Ever since I got back to{NEWLINE}Johto, I’ve regretted never{CLEAR}repaying you for saving my life.{CLEAR}Please take this as my thanks!

strings.zh: 每日在这喇叭芽之塔上,{NEWLINE}净是打坐参禅无聊的紧。{CLEAR}恩公你既然来了,{CLEAR}可有时间与我活动活动筋骨？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Every day up in this Sprout{NEWLINE}Tower, it’s nothing but sitting and{CLEAR}meditating. Boring as all get-out. Now{CLEAR}that you’re here, my benefactor, you{CLEAR}got time to stretch your limbs with me?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 洒家单打双打都没问题,{NEWLINE}你喜欢哪种打法？
strings.en: Singles or doubles, this old boy’s{NEWLINE}fine with either. Which do you like?

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 哈哈,那就来吧！
strings.en: Ha ha, then bring it on!

strings.zh: 痛快,能跟你在这大战一场,{NEWLINE}胜过吃斋念佛千百倍！
strings.en: What a thrill! A big battle with{NEWLINE}you here beats eating vegetarian and{CLEAR}chanting sutras a thousand times over!

strings.zh: 你就带着一只精灵啊,{NEWLINE}洒家可不干那以多欺少的勾当。
strings.en: You’ve only got one Pokémon with you.{NEWLINE}This old boy doesn’t gang up on anyone.

strings.zh: 大食花『Viii——tree！
strings.en: Victreebel: Viii-tree!

strings.zh: 嗯嗯,狗肉可真好吃……
strings.en: Mmm, mmm... dog meat sure is tasty...

strings.zh: 不是啊长老,{NEWLINE}我没有躲起来吃狗肉！
strings.en: No, Elder! I wasn’t hiding{NEWLINE}up here eating dog meat!

strings.zh: 施主您好,行百里者半九十,{NEWLINE}您即将登顶喇叭芽之塔,{CLEAR}这最后的一份功德{CLEAR}不知道您是否愿意施舍呢？
strings.en: Greetings, traveler. As they{NEWLINE}say, ninety miles is only half of{CLEAR}a hundred-mile journey. You are{CLEAR}about to reach the top of Sprout{CLEAR}Tower. Would you be willing to{CLEAR}make this one final offering?

strings.zh: 施主坚守初心,{NEWLINE}不愿修行半途而废,{NEWLINE}小僧甚是佩服！
strings.en: You hold true to your original{NEWLINE}purpose and will not abandon{CLEAR}your training halfway. This{CLEAR}humble monk greatly admires you!

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,古代的喇叭芽通过修行,{NEWLINE}便能化成擎起高塔的巨柱。{CLEAR}不禁让我们这些后人肃然起敬。
strings.en: Amitabha. Through training, the{NEWLINE}Bellsprout of ancient times became the{CLEAR}giant pillar that holds up this tower. We{CLEAR}who came after can only stand in awe.

strings.zh: 哇,这塔的柱子晃来晃去,不会倒吗？
strings.en: Whoa, the tower’s pillar is{NEWLINE}swaying back and forth. It’s{CLEAR}not going to fall down, is it?
